mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(ms_tshark_packet_protocol, 'OTHER') AS protocol, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(ms_tshark_packet_length), 0) AS bytes FROM ms_tshark_packet WHERE ms_tshark_packet_session_id = #{sessionId} GROUP BY COALESCE(ms_tshark_packet_protocol, 'OTHER') ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT (COALESCE(ms_tshark_packet_source_ip, '') || ':' || COALESCE(ms_tshark_packet_source_port, '') || ' -> ' || COALESCE(ms_tshark_packet_dest_ip, '') || ':' || COALESCE(ms_tshark_packet_dest_port, '')) AS flow, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(ms_tshark_packet_length), 0) AS bytes, ms_tshark_packet_source_ip AS sourceIp, ms_tshark_packet_source_port AS sourcePort, ms_tshark_packet_dest_ip AS destIp, ms_tshark_packet_dest_port AS destPort FROM ms_tshark_packet WHERE ms_tshark_packet_session_id = #{sessionId} GROUP BY ms_tshark_packet_source_ip, ms_tshark_packet_source_port, ms_tshark_packet_dest_ip, ms_tshark_packet_dest_port ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE '%[RST%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reset, SUM(CASE WHEN ms_tshark_packet_protocol LIKE 'ICMP%' AND ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE '%unreachable%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unreachable, SUM(CASE WHEN ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE '%[TCP Retransmission]%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retransmission, SUM(CASE WHEN ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE '%[TCP Out-Of-Order]%' OR ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE '%[TCP Out-of-Order]%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outOfOrder, SUM(CASE WHEN ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE '%[TCP ZeroWindow]%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zeroWindow, SUM(CASE WHEN ms_tshark_packet_protocol LIKE 'DNS%' AND (ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE '%No such name%' OR ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE '%NXDOMAIN%' OR ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE '%Non-Existent%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dnsFail, SUM(CASE WHEN ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE 'HTTP/1.1 4%' OR ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE 'HTTP/1.0 4%' OR ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE 'HTTP/2 4%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS http4xx, SUM(CASE WHEN ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE 'HTTP/1.1 5%' OR ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE 'HTTP/1.0 5%' OR ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE 'HTTP/2 5%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS http5xx, SUM(CASE WHEN ms_tshark_packet_protocol LIKE 'TLS%' AND ms_tshark_packet_info LIKE '%Alert%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tlsAlert FROM ms_tshark_packet WHERE ms_tshark_packet_session_id = #{sessionId}
